label.explanation: postgres's data volume climbed past 90% (lines 117, 147, 163) and then filled, so every write failed with "No space left on device" (lines 199, 220, 229). order-service's orders inserts fail as a direct result (lines 201, 228, 234); reads keep working, which is why only writes surface as api-gateway 500s (lines 200, 206, 225, 230, 240, 248, 252, 264, 268, 277, 290, 303). The insert errors look like data problems but the data is fine; it is storage. Red herrings: line 186 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 187 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400); line 50 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out).
